job.name: ig17_host_1
job.meaning: Мудрая женщина ~55, серебристые волосы в пучке, льняная шаль, свечи и сухоцветы, тёплый вечерний свет — «знающая, бабушкина мудрость»
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a calm wise Russian woman about 55 with silver hair in a loose low bun, small silver earrings, a soft oatmeal linen shawl over a cream blouse. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium close shot from the chest up, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm, warm, knowing expression, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a phone camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a cosy wooden room in the evening, a few lit candles and dried flowers on a shelf behind her, softly blurred, warm golden light.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary person (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
